## This week

The division of labor that gives a text-only model hands: judgment to the model as text, execution to code, under the convention that output is read as an execution request. Function calling as the standardized round trip; the tool schema as the entire interface; failures reinjected as readable results; the tool list as the capability boundary — and the honest closing observation that a loop has been running all along, inside the client.

## Lab

`W3_lab_tools.ipynb` — plain Python functions become tools through `aisuite` (docstring-derived schemas); the request–execute–reinject cycle traced; a bad-vs-improved docstring experiment; a measured routing score over a fixed task set (≥ 6/8); and an email assistant whose capability is set entirely by its tool list. Adapted from Andrew Ng's *Agentic AI* Module 3.

Homework: `W3_hw_new_tool.ipynb` — extend the toolbox with a schedule-lookup tool of your own: the function, the docstring written to the checklist, and two routing tasks that prove the model finds it (≥ 7/8). Due before Week 4.

Run it in Colab: click **Open in Colab** (links above), paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
